convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (MA_Rounding_Channel) and external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for both indicator calculation and trade execution logic. Custom indicator buffers must be replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for valid calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal time calculation for trade execution

other_exits: When channel disappears (UpValue[1] or DnValue[1] is 0), EA searches back for last valid channel bar; if Close[1] above last upper channel, closes short; if Close[1] below last lower channel, closes long
Channel continuity mode (ChanContinuity) controls whether channel gaps are filled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM values = fixed lot size (abs value); positive MM values = deposit fraction for risk-based sizing, handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry only triggers when channel exists on closed bar (both Upper and Lower buffers non-zero). Additional entry condition: previous bar had no channel OR close was not already beyond channel line (prevents duplicate signals). When channel disappears, EA performs historical lookback to find last valid channel bar for exit signal generation. SignalBar parameter allows shifting signal source bar (0=current bar real-time, 1=last closed bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs act as master switches for each trade direction and action.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate MA_Rounding_Channel custom indicator: applies MA rounding (rounds price to nearest MaRound multiple) then builds ATR-based channel around it. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh contains 10+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA) - these must all be ported. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles position sizing (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), order execution with deviation, and position management - must be replicated. Channel buffer convention: buffer 1=upper, buffer 2=lower; 0 value = no channel at that bar. The historical lookback for exits when channel disappears adds complexity. SignalBar=0 enables intrabar recalculation (no new-bar guard), SignalBar>=1 only processes on new bar close.
